observations: Fixed eight-TEXT definer recomputes the exact request transcript and derives target only from new-generation digest and immutable configured namespace, explicitly checking profile and binding client/application facts.
Safe exact logout session_user/current_user checks and no-membership checks precede access and are repeated after waits/effect; no table or generic owner revoker grant is added.
Locking reuses original8 command/provider array_to_json advisory keys, then provider/family/generation rows; no later organization/profile/member lock is added.
Command-audit collision is checked before already-ended no-op; an ended family requires exactly one original revoked audit and performs no new write.

Fresh helper applied result is not trusted alone: command/digest/kind/target/revoked outcome/timestamp and unique original audit are checked; post-helper role/namespace/ambiguity failures roll back the effect within a subtransaction.
Inactive or expired callers are not trapped by workspace-domain authorization; legacy/new ambiguity and inconsistent new-family ownership deny.

Controlled service latches before fixed function invocation; uncertain query closes/disposes before propagation, no following SQL/retry; late acquisitions are discarded and success requires acknowledged commit plus awaited physical release.
evidence_status: Actual PostgreSQL/HTTPS final measurements pending; no engine qualification inferred from source review.
